rules.statement: The court has discretion to grant or withhold a commission for examining a sick person under sections 420 and 422.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) If it is for a commission to examine a sick person within the jurisdiction of the court, section 420 would be applicable and a commission to examine in other cases the relevant section is section 422. In either case court is given a discretion to grant or withhold a commission.
